description: The Oshkosh Flyers Football Club offers competitive full-contact youth football for 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th graders. All coaches are USA Football certified, ensuring the safest and most effective training for your young athlete. We compete in the WAAYFL (Wisconsin Area Association Youth Football League).
fee: Contact us for current registration fees
requirements: All players must have a current physical on file. Parents/guardians must complete all registration forms and waivers. Equipment pick-up is required before the first practice.
